abilities.description: You do not need to breathe, eat, or sleep. Your health is not affected by the vacuum of space. You start with all three upgrades on one of your assets already filled—this is your specialty. Then, choose which class of droid you are (at least originally), and always take the bonus of that programming and/or chassis:
Class 1: [physical sciences, medical droids, etc.] +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2051538f0c9d5d27]{Heal} biological life-forms.
Class 3: [protocol, tutor droids, etc.] +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.05909d6310d209a6]{Make a Connection} or help others in doing so.
Class 4: [security droids, battle droids, assassin droids, etc.] +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray}.
Class 5: [general labor, hazardous-service droids, etc.] +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.e6ed148eff82c171]{Face Danger} in your area of expertise.
